recipe.visualDefinition: A retro album cover featuring a high-contrast black and white portrait of a young man in a collared shirt, set against a bright cyan background decorated with vertical white wavy lines and small red heart icons. The layout uses a mix of bold sans-serif and elegant italic serif typography with a distinct 1990s-does-1950s aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait occupies the lower right quadrant within a white-bordered frame.
Wavy white lines flow vertically behind the text on the left side.
Primary artist name spans the top in large, outlined orange letters.
Secondary information is stacked vertically in the left-hand negative space.
coreInvariants: Black and white high-contrast portrait photography
Orange-to-yellow gradient or solid orange main title with black outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the bottom right, framed in a white rectangle, occupying approximately 40% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large orange artist name at the top serves as the primary anchor, followed by the portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down reading of text, then diagonal shift to the portrait, then down to the bottom black footer bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant cyan space on the left used for track listing and decorative wavy lines.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan blue background providing a vibrant, clean retro feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white for the portrait and bottom footer bar.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Orange for the main title and red for small heart icons.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high value (white) and low value (black) graphical elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of geometric sans-serif and high-contrast transitional serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses heavy, wide sans-serif with thick black outlines.
Subtitles use high-contrast, slanted serifs with sharp terminals.
Body text uses clean, all-caps sans-serif for readability.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Italic 'L' and 'T' in the subtitle have elongated, elegant strokes.
Main title letters are tightly tracked with a slight drop shadow effect created by the outline.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, blocky sans-serif for the name paired with elegant, slanted serifs for the title to balance masculinity and romance.
graphicDevices: Black footer bar with spaced-out white text

preserve: Orange/Black color combo for main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and width of the primary display text.
Captures the high-contrast serif look of the subtitle.
Appropriate for the secondary metadata at the bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a bright cyan square background. On the left half, add five vertical, parallel white wavy lines. In the bottom right quadrant, place a framed black and white high-contrast studio portrait of a smiling young man from the 1950s wearing a checkered shirt. Add a black horizontal bar at the very bottom. Place two small red hearts in the upper left area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main artist name in large, bold, orange all-caps sans-serif with a black outline at the top. Below it, add the album title in white italic serif with a thin black outline. List song titles in small black sans-serif in the center-left space. Add metadata in white spaced-out sans-serif on the bottom black bar.

verificationChecks: Is the background a vibrant cyan?
Are the wavy lines white and vertical?
Is the portrait black and white and framed?
Is the main title orange with a black outline?

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all graphic elements
High contrast in the B&W portrait

postGenerationChecks: Check that the orange text is legible against the cyan.
Ensure the wavy lines do not obscure the song list.
Verify the black footer bar is perfectly horizontal.
Confirm the portrait is strictly black and white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Cyan background + vertical white waves + B&W framed portrait + orange outlined display type = Mid-century Pop Aesthetic.
